resources.string: Send an image without saving the number
No contact will be created. The number and image stay on this device.
Open chat with this number (no image)
Presses the recipient and Send inside WhatsApp for you

Lets Image Sender finish a send you started: once WhatsApp opens with your photo attached, it taps the number you entered and then Send. It reads WhatsApp screens only while a send is in progress, and never stores or transmits anything.
On — WhatsApp opens, picks the number and sends by itself.
Off — you tap the number and Send inside WhatsApp.

Sending to %1$s.\n\nThis app cannot check whether the number is registered on WhatsApp; if it is not, WhatsApp will say so and nothing is sent.

WhatsApp opens with the photo attached. Depending on the WhatsApp version it either lands on this chat or asks you to tap the number in its list — the number appears there even when it is not a contact, so nothing is ever saved. Turn on Auto-send to skip those taps.
Auto-send is on: WhatsApp opens, picks this number and presses Send by itself. If WhatsApp changes its layout, finish the send by hand — nothing is lost.
